headline: TikToker's wedding ceremony stampede claims two lives in Sialkot
subheadline: Police register case, arrest six suspects; prime suspects remain at large
author: Umar Ijaz
article_text:
Eight nominated, 45 unidentified people named.
Six suspects arrested in connection with incident.
Main suspect remains at large, say police.

At least two people have died and several others sustained injuries in a stampede during a mehndi ceremony on Daska Road in Sialkot, police said.

The stampede occurred during a mehndi ceremony at Faraz Sports Stadium on Daska Road on Saturday, leaving 14 people injured, according to rescue officials.

Police have registered a case over the stampede, nominating eight people and including 45 unidentified individuals, while six suspects have been arrested.

The main suspect, who is also nominated in the case, remains at large, with efforts underway to arrest him, police said.

According to police, one person was killed on Saturday while another injured person succumbed to his injuries on Sunday, taking the death toll to two.

Khawaja Asif calls for social media accountability

Separately, Defence Minister Khawaja Asif strongly condemned the incident, alleging that a TikToker, known as ‘Patlu’, had attracted a large crowd to his wedding celebrations by announcing valuable prizes, including substantial cash rewards.

In a statement on X, the minister alleged that the prizes were an investment to attract people and generate revenue through social media platforms.

He said the incident had exploited the poverty of local residents, resulting in the loss of two lives and injuries to dozens of people.

Asif said that the TikToker was absconding and using his influence to evade the law.

Warning against the potential consequences of unregulated social media activity, he called for accountability and questioned whether existing tax laws adequately regulate the substantial earnings of social media influencers.

headline: Zara Tindall sparks trouble in new conflict with King, Prince William's code
subheadline: King Charles's niece Zara faces fresh dilemma as new reports reveal surprising details
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Zara Tindall’s decision sparks major concerns as fresh crisis knocks at royal’s door.

There are few members of the royal family that the King relies on, knowing that they can be trusted to stay out of trouble, which includes Princess Anne’s daughter.

Zara, who is not a working member of the family but has remained steadfast in her support for the King and the Firm, unexpectedly landed in some trouble as new details come to light.

READ MORE: Prince William breaks silence after Duchy of Cornwall decision backfires

The equestrian supports many noble causes, which includes advocacy for ocean conversation and animal protection.

Moreover, given how outspoken the King and Prince William are about the environment and ethically practices, the latest developments have brought a contradiction.

A luxury jewellery company, Calleija, was found to have sourced its diamonds from Australia’s Argyle mine, which has been at the centre of the environmental contamination concerns.

Zara, who had a collection made in collaboration with the brand, has not yet made a statement on the matter. Although there is no indication that Zara had prior knowledge of the mine’s contamination.

The owner has defended his company stating that it has been “fastidious about where our natural diamonds, gems and precious metals are sourced”.

This also comes after singer Ellie Goulding, a WWF ambassador, said she was “mortified” after being photographed wearing Argyle diamonds.

It remains to be seen if Zara will make a statement on the matter.

headline: Meg Mathews recalls shocking moment she discovered she had breast cancer
subheadline: Meg has also revealed what led her to undergo a double mastectomy after being diagnosed with breast cancer in November 2024
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Meg Mathews has shared the devastating news of her health, revealing she had been secretly battling breast cancer.

Musician Noel Gallaher's ex-wife and businessman by profession has lifted the lid on her health scare as she has spoken for the first time which needs guts.

Moreover, Meg also shared what made her to have a double mastectomy after being diagnosed in November 2024.

READ MORE: Katie Price responds to Meg Mathews' puppy row

Meg revealed a routine mammogram found three 'pea-sized lumps' under her left breast and she was told she had HER2-negative breast cancer.

The columnist revealed her shock at being told she had cancer because she 'felt great' and 'would never have known that I had any illness whatsoever', with the lumps being hard to find as they were at the back by her milk glands.

In an interview, Meg reflected on the moment she was told of her diagnosis two years ago.

She told The Sun: 'I didn’t feel scared when I got the diagnosis. I just thought: "I can’t break down and think: poor me". I’m strong, I’m going to get through it.’ 'I knew I had to stay positive because it could have gone the other way and I could have relapsed.'

Meg quit drinking in 2017 after her 51st birthday. She had battled alcohol and substance dependency stemming from her early teens and peaking during the 1990s Britpop era.

READ MORE: Noel Gallagher ex wife Patsy Kensit rules out finding love again

headline: Pakistan beat Oman by 18 runs to win Hong Kong Sixes Plate title
subheadline: Pakistan finish fifth after failing to defend their Hong Kong Sixes title
author: Sports Desk
article_text:
Pakistan defeated Oman by 18 runs in the Plate final of the Hong Kong Sixes 2026 to claim the second-tier title after failing to retain their championship crown at Mission Road Ground in Mong Kok on Sunday.

Batting first, the Men in Green posted an imposing 154-4 in their allotted six overs, with captain Abbas Afridi leading from the front with a blistering 73 off just 16 deliveries, featuring one four and 11 sixes. He subsequently retired before returning to the crease in the final over.

Abdul Samad chipped in with 26 off five deliveries, including two boundaries and three sixes, while opener Khawaja Nafay scored seven off three balls, including a six.

Ahmed Daniyal added a quickfire 25 off five deliveries, smashing four sixes, while Muhammad Shahzad contributed 13 off four balls, including two sixes. Irfan Niazi, meanwhile, was dismissed for a first-ball duck.

In reply, Oman managed 136-4 in their allotted six overs despite a dominant opening partnership between Usman Ali and Zohaib Amanat. Captain Aamir Kaleem was the first batter dismissed, falling for a duck following a run-out effected by Ahmed Daniyal.

Usman led Oman's charge with a magnificent 67 off just 17 deliveries, striking four boundaries and eight sixes, while Amanat contributed 61 off 18 balls, featuring four boundaries and eight sixes.

Oman's remaining batters, Sami Hassan, Shafiq Jan and Muzahir Khan, were retired out as the side attempted to keep its leading batters at the crease. Usman subsequently returned to the crease following the dismissal of the first wicket, prompting the retirement of the three batters.

It is pertinent to mention that six-time champions Pakistan concluded their Hong Kong Sixes 2026 campaign without defending their main title, eventually securing the Plate championship to finish fifth in the tournament standings.

The Green Shirts began their campaign with a defeat against the UAE in their Group C opener. Batting first, Pakistan posted 106-3 in their allotted six overs, with captain Abbas Afridi leading from the front with a blistering 53 off just 13 deliveries, featuring one four and eight sixes.

In response, the UAE comfortably chased down the 107-run target, courtesy of a sensational knock from captain Khalid Shah, who smashed 71 off just 20 deliveries, including three fours and nine sixes.

Pakistan bounced back in their second Group C fixture, defeating arch-rivals India. The Men in Blue posted 88-5 in their allotted six overs, but Pakistan chased down the target in just 3.5 overs, losing only two wickets.

Khawaja Nafay spearheaded the successful chase with an explosive 41 off 12 deliveries, featuring two fours and five sixes, while captain Abbas Afridi provided further impetus with an unbeaten 35 off just eight balls, including one four and five sixes.

However, Pakistan's hopes of defending their title suffered a major setback when the UAE defeated India to register their second victory in Group C. The result secured the UAE's progression to the main trophy competition, while Pakistan were relegated to the Plate championship.

In the Plate competition, Pakistan faced hosts Hong Kong in the second semi-final and registered a comprehensive victory. Chasing a target of 107, the Green Shirts reached the winning total without losing a wicket, with Abbas Afridi once again leading from the front.

The Pakistan captain smashed an unbeaten 55 off just 13 deliveries, including three fours and seven sixes, to guide his side into the Plate final.

headline: Pakistan assumes G-24 chairmanship, stresses more inclusive global financial system
subheadline: FinMin Aurangzeb underscores importance of aligning financial stability with long-term development objectives
author: Web Desk
article_text:
FinMin describes G-24 chairmanship as "profound responsibility".
Developing nations' economies drivers of innovation: Aurangzeb.
FinMin reiterates commitment to advancing the G-24's mission.

Pakistan has assumed the chairmanship of the Intergovernmental Group of Twenty-Four (G-24), reiterating its pledge to strengthening the collective voice of developing economies and advancing a fair and development-oriented international financial system, the finance ministry said on Sunday.

Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb described the chairmanship as a profound responsibility, calling for renewed international cooperation, stronger multilateral institutions and reinforced global commitments to address climate shocks, development financing gaps and global economic fragmentation, according to the finance ministry.

"The future of developing economies is not peripheral to the future of the global economy. It is central to it," Aurangzeb said, highlighting the immense potential of emerging and developing nations as drivers of investment, innovation, entrepreneurship and global growth.

The finance czar outlined three priorities: development-led growth, stronger representation for developing economies and reform of international financial architecture.

Aurangzeb said that Pakistan, as the G-24 chair, will prioritise placing development at the centre of global economic policymaking.

He stressed that macroeconomic stability must serve as a foundation for investment, productivity, employment and shared prosperity, enabling developing and low-income economies to move beyond crisis management towards sustainable growth.

Secondly, Aurangzeb said that Pakistan would advocate for strengthening multilateral frameworks for the collective benefit of members through more inclusive and representative institutions.

Pakistan will advocate for more equitable and fair governance, meaningful participation in decision-making and greater responsiveness of the Bretton Woods institutions to the evolving needs and realities of their members, he added.

The country's third priority as the G-24 chairman will be advancing a development-oriented international financial architecture.

Priorities will include affordable and timely development financing, sustainable debt solutions, stronger global financial safety nets, climate resilience and greater mobilisation of public and private capital, he said.

"Our task is to ensure that the immense potential of developing economies is not constrained by an international financial architecture that has yet to fully adapt to a changing world," he emphasised.

'Necessary financing'

Drawing on Pakistan's own experience of economic stabilisation, reform and resilience, the finance minister underscored the importance of aligning financial stability with long-term development objectives, while ensuring that reforming economies have the necessary financing and policy space to pursue sustainable growth.

He reaffirmed that Pakistan's chairmanship would be guided by the G-24's longstanding principles of consultation, consensus and collective advocacy, working closely with members across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, alongside the IMF, World Bank and other international partners, to translate shared priorities into practical outcomes.

Senator Aurangzeb also acknowledged Nigeria's leadership as outgoing chair and expressed Pakistan's commitment to building on the Group's progress.

The finance minister stressed that the effectiveness of collective leadership must be judged by tangible development outcomes.

"The true measure of our collective leadership will not simply be the strength of our voice, but the difference that voice makes," he stated.

He reaffirmed Pakistan's commitment to advancing the G-24's mission "from collective voice to collective influence, and from collective influence to meaningful progress."

article_html:
• FinMin describes G-24 chairmanship as "profound responsibility".
  • Developing nations' economies drivers of innovation: Aurangzeb.
  • FinMin reiterates commitment to advancing the G-24's mission.

Pakistan has assumed the chairmanship of the Intergovernmental Group of Twenty-Four (G-24), reiterating its pledge to strengthening the collective voice of developing economies and advancing a fair and development-oriented international financial system, the finance ministry said on Sunday.

Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb described the chairmanship as a profound responsibility, calling for renewed international cooperation, stronger multilateral institutions and reinforced global commitments to address climate shocks, development financing gaps and global economic fragmentation, according to the finance ministry.

"The future of developing economies is not peripheral to the future of the global economy. It is central to it," Aurangzeb said, highlighting the immense potential of emerging and developing nations as drivers of investment, innovation, entrepreneurship and global growth.

The finance czar outlined three priorities: development-led growth, stronger representation for developing economies and reform of international financial architecture.

Aurangzeb said that Pakistan, as the G-24 chair, will prioritise placing development at the centre of global economic policymaking.

He stressed that macroeconomic stability must serve as a foundation for investment, productivity, employment and shared prosperity, enabling developing and low-income economies to move beyond crisis management towards sustainable growth.

Secondly, Aurangzeb said that Pakistan would advocate for strengthening multilateral frameworks for the collective benefit of members through more inclusive and representative institutions.

Pakistan will advocate for more equitable and fair governance, meaningful participation in decision-making and greater responsiveness of the Bretton Woods institutions to the evolving needs and realities of their members, he added.

The country's third priority as the G-24 chairman will be advancing a development-oriented international financial architecture.

Priorities will include affordable and timely development financing, sustainable debt solutions, stronger global financial safety nets, climate resilience and greater mobilisation of public and private capital, he said.

"Our task is to ensure that the immense potential of developing economies is not constrained by an international financial architecture that has yet to fully adapt to a changing world," he emphasised.

'Necessary financing'

Drawing on Pakistan's own experience of economic stabilisation, reform and resilience, the finance minister underscored the importance of aligning financial stability with long-term development objectives, while ensuring that reforming economies have the necessary financing and policy space to pursue sustainable growth.

He reaffirmed that Pakistan's chairmanship would be guided by the G-24's longstanding principles of consultation, consensus and collective advocacy, working closely with members across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, alongside the IMF, World Bank and other international partners, to translate shared priorities into practical outcomes.

Senator Aurangzeb also acknowledged Nigeria's leadership as outgoing chair and expressed Pakistan's commitment to building on the Group's progress.

The finance minister stressed that the effectiveness of collective leadership must be judged by tangible development outcomes.

"The true measure of our collective leadership will not simply be the strength of our voice, but the difference that voice makes," he stated.

He reaffirmed Pakistan's commitment to advancing the G-24's mission "from collective voice to collective influence, and from collective influence to meaningful progress."

headline: Robert Downey Jr., Pedro Pascal pull off hilarious Halloween costume swap
subheadline: From Marvel rivals to Halloween besties RDJ and Pedro Pascal's is having fun this Spooktober
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Who said superheroes and supervillains can't have a little Halloween fun together?

Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal just gave Marvel fans a costume reveal worth celebrating.

The Avengers: Doomsday co-stars decided to turn the tables on their upcoming Marvel rivalry by swapping characters for Halloween.

READ MORE: Jeremy Renner predicts ‘Avengers: Doomsday' heroes are in trouble for one reason

Downey Jr., who is set to portray Doctor Doom, stepped into the look associated with Pascal's Reed Richards, aka Mr. Fantastic, while Pascal took on Doom's intimidating masked appearance.

Sharing a video on his social media, Downey Jr. teased fans with the cheeky caption, "Victor. Richard. Costume swap!"

The clip began with Pascal casually pulling back his hoodie before Downey Jr. slowly lowered his hand from his face.

Then came the big reveal: Pascal uncovered his mask while Downey dropped both hands, unveiling the two actors in their swapped superhero outfits.

Pascal's green MIT hoodie was an especially clever touch, adding another little nod to Tony Stark's iconic Marvel history.

But apparently, posing in each other's costumes wasn't enough mischief for these two.

In another Instagram Stories video, Downey Jr. gave fans a glimpse of their off-camera fun as the pair strolled arm-in-arm down a quiet street at night, holding hands and even breaking into some dancing.

With Avengers: Doomsday scheduled to hit theatres on December 18, fans are already looking forward to seeing these two share the screen.

READ MORE: Patrick Stewart to make last on-screen appearance in 'Avengers: Doomsday'

headline: King Charles team issues message as monarch hit with alarming setback
subheadline: Royal family receives upsetting update about King Charles
author: Web Desk
article_text:
King Charles' team responded after the monarch suffered a major setback amid ongoing talks about Andrew's investigation and Prince Harry's UK showdown.

The monarch is on his nine-day Caribbean tour, but back in the UK, the royal family received an upsetting update.

According to the latest poll, the king's popularity has dropped, an alarming piece of news for the royals.

READ MORE: Buckingham Palace shares King Charles next move as apology calls grow

However, a Palace aide sent a clear message that the monarch is "confident" in how he is handling his royal duties and the family crisis.

As per Hello! Magazine, the Palace's source said, "Yes. That is why he takes the actions he does - and has done." King Charles is not only the head of the family but also the Head of State. An insider shared, "Busy people get lots done.

"The King rigorously prioritises his multiple roles, as Head of State, church, Commonwealth, military and family. The order of priority shifts by the day - and often by the hour."

It is important to note that Andrew has once again returned to the news after Police Scotland shared that it is investigating Andrew's visits to Balmoral with Jeffrey Epstein and his partner Ghislaine Maxwell.

Also, an investigation against Andrew on suspicion of misconduct in public office is going on.

READ MORE: King Charles issues instruction to royals over Thomas Markle probe

The other issue the royals have been facing is the Duke and Duchess of Sussex's UK takeover.

headline: Jesy Nelson's fans remind critics that mums deserve break amid Paris getaway backlash
subheadline: It comes after Jesy reportedly 'pulled out of I'm A Celebrity to care for her twin daughters
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Jesy Nelson's fans have shown nothing but support for the star after she faced criticism for spending time with her new boyfriend, Ben Davies, without her twin babies.

The Little Mix star, 35, and her new partner travelled to Paris, the French capital, after reports emerged that she had 'pulled out' of a six-figure deal to appear on the next series of I'm A Celeb.... Get Me Out of Here!.

While the star looked happier than ever in the snaps, Jesy received mixed reactions, with some people taking a swipe at her for holidaying without her daughters, both of whom suffer with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) and need round-the-clock medical care.

READ MORE: Jesy Nelson faces difficult choice between daughters and career move

One person cruelly remarked: 'I’d be spending all my time with my children not some guy that’ll last a few months….', causing Jesy to hit back, writing: 'oh Sami hun have a day off.'

'Kids come first' 'Concentrate on those children.'

However, Jesy's supporters slammed the naysayers for their comments, remarking that Jesy and other mums deserve happiness as well as a break from parenting.

Taking to the comments, they penned: 'Mums can't pour from an empty cup, especially those who have twin babies with complex needs. A happy Jesy = an even better Mummy

It comes after Jesy reportedly 'pulled out of I'm A Celebrity to care for her twin daughters.

New reports have claimed 'there is no way' Jesy would leave her children to go into the Australian jungle.

READ MORE: Jesy Nelson says daughters 'will one day blame her' over SMA diagnosis

headline: Hailey, Justin Bieber's Halloween looks spark mixed reactions
subheadline: Justin and Hailey Bieber opt for a contrasting Devil and Angel theme for this year's spooky occasion
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Hailey and Justin Bieber, a match made in Heaven... or Hell?

It's an angel-and-devil kind of Halloween for the celebrity couple as they gave fans a double dose of fashion with their contrasting costumes.

While Hailey's heavenly transformation is winning hearts, Justin's devilish look has sparked a rather divided conversation online.

READ MORE: Justin Bieber shares sweet selfie with wife Hailey in new photo dump

Sharing professionally captured photographs on their respective Instagram accounts, the Biebers embraced the ultimate opposites-attract theme.

The Rhode founder looked straight out of heaven, rocking a white bralette beneath a cropped white jacket, black shorts and dramatic feathered headwear.

Completing her angelic transformation, she posed confidently atop a fluffy cloud prop, sporting enormous white wings that made the entire look feel like a heavenly fashion editorial.

The Baby hitmaker, meanwhile, decided to take the opposite route!

He went full devil mode in a striking red leather jacket and matching trousers, accessorised with a horned beanie, tinted goggles, a moustache and a nose ring.

His intense close-up shots added an extra dose of rebellious rockstar energy to the transformation.

The internet had plenty to say! While many fans adored the coordinated contrast, celebrating the pairing as a “heavenly angel + naughty devil” moment, others weren't quite as enthusiastic.

Justin's choice of devil-inspired costume prompted questions from some social media users, particularly in light of his publicly expressed Christian faith.

Reactions ranged from playful praise for the couple's Halloween creativity to disappointment and criticism.

READ MORE: Real reason why Justin, Hailey Bieber asked carl Lentz to leave their house

headline: Maura Higgins reveals emotional struggle on 'Dancing With The Stars'
subheadline: The Love Island star, 35, is currently competing on 'Dancing With The Stars' alongside her professional dance partner Mark Ballas
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Maura Higgins appears to be having some exhausting days.

The Love Island star, 35, is currently competing on Dancing With The Stars alongside her professional dance partner Mark Ballas.

Maura shared a sombre selfie on her Instagram Stories during rehearsals, and what caught fans' attention was that the star appeared to under immense pressure.

The television personality looked exhausted as she lay on a sofa and wiped her eye.

READ MORE: ‘The Traitors' star Maura Higgins gets major career boost with Disney+

She captioned the post: 'Struggling so much this week' followed by a crying face emoji.

It comes after Maura transformed into 'vampire mode' during Horror Movie Night on Dancing With The Stars on Tuesday.

The reality star recently opened up about how she deals with negative feedback which she received from the judges and her partner, Mark Ballas, who has reportedly been urging her 'fix everything' during rehearsals.

Despite the Love Island star being tipped as one of the favourites to win the series, she admitted that she has been 'crying in the toilets' during rehearsals.

READ MORE: Maura Higgins and Giovanni Pernice end their romantic journey

headline: Princess Kate receives gracious message from Harry ahead of key event
subheadline: Prince Harry honours Princess Kate’s important mission with kind gesture
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince Harry, despite the slew of setbacks in the possible reconciliation plans, has extended, in what appears to be, an olive branch to his sister-in-law the Princess Kate.

The rift between Prince William and Prince Harry has only been growing deeper with the series of events that have happened, especially after the Sussexes have returned.

While the King had cracked the door open for his younger son, William and Catherine have stayed prudent in their approach in the matter.

READ MORE: Prince Harry clears stance on clash with King Charles, Prince William

However, things went awry when major diary clashes took place in recent weeks. The most prominent among them was his GQ interview release coincided with the ceremonial welcome and State Banquet for the Sultan of Oman.

Even though a Sussex spokesperson cleared that it was the publication’s decision to release it at the time, it did not help matters with the royals.

Now, sources have claimed that Princess Kate will be joining her husband Prince William in India for the Earthshot Prize. It was likely that the event could have coincided with one of the Sussex events.

Hence, the Sussex camp has shared that the couple are holding off public engagements for the time being. Harry’s representative also noted that he doesn’t want to overshadow the royals.

According to Woman & Home’s Emma Shacklock, this comes as a “respectful” gesture from Harry, knowing that this means a lot to the Waleses.

She explained that the Duke of Sussex “holding off from any public appearances during this time would ensure that focus remains on the Waleses and the awards themselves”.

This could suggest that it was an olive branch from Harry to Kate, with whom he once shared a very close bond.

READ MORE: Prince Harry turns ‘fly on wall' for important discussion after major loss

The rift between Prince William and Prince Harry has only been growing deeper with the series of events that have happened, especially after the Sussexes have returned.

While the King had cracked the door open for his younger son, William and Catherine have stayed prudent in their approach in the matter.

READ MORE: Prince Harry clears stance on clash with King Charles, Prince William

However, things went awry when major diary clashes took place in recent weeks. The most prominent among them was his GQ interview release coincided with the ceremonial welcome and State Banquet for the Sultan of Oman.

Even though a Sussex spokesperson cleared that it was the publication’s decision to release it at the time, it did not help matters with the royals.

Now, sources have claimed that Princess Kate will be joining her husband Prince William in India for the Earthshot Prize. It was likely that the event could have coincided with one of the Sussex events.

Hence, the Sussex camp has shared that the couple are holding off public engagements for the time being. Harry’s representative also noted that he doesn’t want to overshadow the royals.

According to Woman & Home’s Emma Shacklock, this comes as a “respectful” gesture from Harry, knowing that this means a lot to the Waleses.

She explained that the Duke of Sussex “holding off from any public appearances during this time would ensure that focus remains on the Waleses and the awards themselves”.

This could suggest that it was an olive branch from Harry to Kate, with whom he once shared a very close bond.

headline: Lee Andrews sends romantic message to estranged wife Katie Price amid split
subheadline: The post comes as Katie is set to expose her estranged husband, Lee Andrews, in a new documentary about alleged swindlers
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Is this a reunion hint?

Lee Andrews has one again hinted at a possible reunion with his estranged wife, Katie Price, by calling her 'his soulmate.'

The post comes as Katie is set to expose her estranged husband, Lee Andrews, in a new documentary about alleged swindlers.

Katie will join a number of people who claim to have fallen victim to the alleged fraudster.

READ MORE: Katie Price 'calls time' on marriage to Lee Andrews after shocking crypto discovery

Now Lee has now tagged Katie in a post about “soulmates” and “knowing where his heart is” – and the former glamour model has shared the same post on her Instagram story.

It read: “They say soulmates recognise each other instantly. “I think that’s why I felt so comfortable from the start.

“I didn’t need time to understand how much you mean to me.

“My heart already knew.

“You’re not just my person, you’re my forever.”

The Sun reported last week that the TV star was seen wearing the huge diamond ring again, and in a recent social media posts, the ring has remained firmly on her left hand.

headline: Niall Horan dresses up as Woody for Toy Story-themed Halloween concert
subheadline: You've got a friend in Niall! One Direction star gives fans a ‘Toy Story’ surprise in Munich
author: Javeria Shahid
article_text:
Howdy, partner…Niall Horan just proved that Halloween concerts can go to infinity and beyond.

The former One Direction star gave fans a seriously adorable surprise in Munich, Germany.

He transformed into none other than Woody from Toy Story and brought the beloved animated classic straight to the concert stage.

READ MORE: Harry Styles becomes iconic pizza rat for Halloween MSG finale

Performing at Olympiahalle on Saturday, October 31, as part of his Dinner Party Live On Tour, the Slow Hands hitmaker turned the Halloween night into a full-blown Toy Story celebration.

Ditching his usual concert look, he stepped into Woody's cowboy boots, complete with the iconic cowboy hat, yellow shirt, cow-print vest, red bandana and jeans. And he wasn't playing sheriff alone!

His band members joined the fun by dressing up as other Toy Story characters, including the little green army men, making the entire performance feel like Andy's toys had somehow escaped into a Niall concert.

Taking to his Instagram Stories the Irish musician made a hilarious reel with his team and also posted several glimpses from the night.

The X Factor alum and his band performed Randy Newman's beloved You've Got a Friend in Me, sending fans into a nostalgic frenzy.

Marking the final German date of the European tour leg, the Munich concert turned into a particularly memorable Halloween celebration.

READ MORE: Niall Horan drops new ‘This Town' fan edition video after major milestone

article_text:
It's Halloween spirit!

When there are number of celebrities making their festive celebrations special and unique with their eye-grabbing looks, Holly Willoughby has also joined the Halloween spirit.

The TV presenter, took to Instagram on Saturday to share her look for this year's Halloween celebrations.

Holly showed off a frightening look featuring red eyes and a bonnet, posing in front of an elaborately decorated front door covered in skeletons, pumpkins and flowers.

READ MORE: Holly Willoughby set to return to mainstream TV with new women focused show

Holly captioned the post: 'Tis the season of the Witch… Happy Halloween everyone. Thank you @earlyhoursltd for the spook-a-licious display 18h.'

View this post on Instagram A post shared by Holly Willoughby (@hollywilloughby)

Fans and celebrity friends quickly flocked to the comments section, with one writing: 'Amazing..love the eyes.'

Former TOWIE star Jess Wright also liked the post.

The outing comes after Holly was spotted enjoying a much-needed break with her sister, Kelly, with the pair having a blast while holidaying together.

headline: King Charles, Prince Harry's 'secret' deal sparks public fury
subheadline: Prince Harry gives fresh tension to King Charles during his Caribbean tour
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Was Prince Harry the reason behind King Charles' declining popularity? Well, a royal commentator thinks so.

A recent poll revealed a dip in positive thinking among the public about the monarch since the return of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex.

According to Tom Skyes, the monarch's hidden support to make the Sussexes' UK return smooth could be the reason behind the public's fury.

READ MORE: King Charles team issues message as monarch hit with alarming setback

The royal expert said, "The public are not fooled. They know Charles is behind the return of Harry. They do not buy the line that he didn't know, that the King was as surprised as anyone to find his younger son setting up home in the Cotswolds."

As per The Express, he added, "The public drew the obvious conclusion: that the King has wanted Harry home all along and done nothing to prevent it, even at terrific cost to a legacy already trashed by Andrew (Mountbatten Windsor)."

READ MORE: Prince William, Princess Kate's secret mission exposed

However, Palace sources did not pay heed to the recent poll, stating that the King and his team are 'confident' of handling family matters.

headline: Maya Jama's friends break silence on King Kenny romance rumours
subheadline: King Kenny was spotted leaving Maya Jama's London flat the morning after the Celebrity Traitors final
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Is this a possible romance angle?

King Kenny was spotted leaving Maya Jama's London flat the morning after the Celebrity Traitors final.

It comes after fans fans picked up on signs of 'flirtation' between her and Celebrity Traitors-co star King Kenny.

However, the DailyMail has reported that the Youtuber and boxer stayed at Maya's home for two nights. Kenny, 29, was also spotted heading to the filming of Celebrity Traitors Uncloaked filming from Maya's flat, accoridng to the pictures obtained by The Sun.

READ MORE: Maya Jama faces major career move as BBC reportedly makes big offer

However, sources close to Maya, 32, have dispelled any romance rumours and insisted the pair are just good friends, adding that Kenny slept on her sofa.

One of the sources said she is single as they told the publication: 'Maya and Kenny are just friends. There is nothing romantic between them.

'Kenny has been firmly on the sofa this week and the pair find it hilarious that their relationship could be anything else. They’ve seen fans of the show talking about them online and find it really funny, but romance has not and is not on the cards.

'Maya has a group of friends staying with her at the moment and Kenny has also been coming to hang out with them. They’ve all been watching the Traitors final together, as well as getting their costumes ready for the Halloween party tonight.'

The insider added they are 'really good friends' and have built a 'strong bond' from being on the show together.

Maya split from Manchester City footballer Ruben Dias in May after 18 months of dating and just four months after they moved into their Cheshire home together.

headline: Sydney Sweeney, Scooter Braun give fans glimpse of Halloween looks
subheadline: Sydney Sweeney and Scooter Braun first connected in June 2025
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Sydney Sweeney and Scooter Braun gave fans another sweet look at their relationship as they celebrated Halloween together.

The couple chose a fun and simple look this year, leaving behind the fancy costumes they wore for their previous dress up.

Sydney shared a mirror picture on her Instagram Stories, showing herself and Scooter in matching brown animal onesies.

They, however, also got same face paint, making their outfits look even more alike. Scooter, whereas, stood behind Sydney with his arms around her while she smiled at the camera.

READ MORE: Sydney Sweeney gets close to Michele Morrone while filming 'The Housemaid 2'

"Happy Halloween from your favourite party animals," Sydney wrote alongside the picture.

The couple clearly enjoy dressing up together. During a trip to Sydney's family home in Idaho in August, they picked two famous superhero looks.

The Housemaid actress dressed as Wonder Woman, complete with a gold tiara, red boots and a superhero outfit meanwhile, the businessman joined her as Superman, wearing the character's famous suit.

Their time together is not only about dressing up and having fun. The pair were also seen holding hands during a walk in New York City on October 29.

READ MORE: Claudia Sulewski and Finneas are still on cloud nine two months after wedding

Sydney has never hidden how much she appreciates her boyfriend. In a birthday message for Scooter in June, she called him a "once in a lifetime" man and thanked him for making her smile again.

headline: Princess Kate fails to hold back emotions for William during crucial duty
subheadline: Princess Kate rejoices special moment as Prince William receives nod of approval from King Charles
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince William and Princess Kate have remained steadfast and loyal to each other through many challenges in their lives during their courtship and the marriage.

Sources close to them share that the Prince and Princess of Wales have grown stronger in their marriage especially after Kate’s cancer journey.

The future king and queen, who share three children together, now face an important mission ahead of them for the monarchy as their destined roles await them.

READ MORE: Prince William breaks silence after Duchy of Cornwall decision backfires

While the couple is strictly professional in royal duties, there are rare moments that shows a glimpse of their bond. One of those moments happened during the State Banquet for Oman last month, where Catherine could not help hide her emotions.

While King Charles was giving a speech, he praised his son, Prince William, in kind words. He also showed is confidence in him to take over the throne when the time comes.

“Our connections matter deeply and, in this regard, I have been especially delighted to see our sons, the Prince of Wales and His Highness Sayyid Theyazin, become joint patrons of the Jewel of Arabia Expedition,” the King had said.

When William was mentioned, Kate couldn’t stop a big smile breaking out when her husband was given the nod of approval.

READ MORE: Princess Kate receives gracious message from Harry ahead of key event

headline: Ozzy Osbourne's unreleased music to feature in upcoming biopic
subheadline: Ozzy died of a heart attack on July 22, 2025, at the age of 76, two weeks after he performed his last gig, Back To The Beginning, at Villa Park in Birmingham
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Ozzy Osbourne may have left millions of fans heartbroken, but his voice will live forever.

According to the latest reports, two previously unheard tracks by the Paranoid hitmaker are set to be released.

He is said to have secretly worked on several songs with producer Andrew Watt while working on his 2022 album, Patient Number 9.

They are now expected to be made public to coincide with the upcoming movie being made about his life.

READ MORE: Ozzy Osbourne, Prince of Darkness, dies at 76

A source told The Sun: 'Ozzy had a practical outlook about his medical issues and life. He was very excited to be in the studio for the Patient Number 9 sessions because Andrew managed to bring energy and excitement, even though he was struggling with his ailments.

'They worked on the album and Ozzy knew that, with the biopic in development, he saw an idea for works about his life and romance with Sharon. Those tracks have only been heard by Andrew and his musicians.'

The songs are described as still being 'works in progress', and even Ozzy's widow Sharon Osbourne, who managed his career, hasn't heard them.

The insider added: 'The final mixes have not even been finished. They remain works in progress and to be considered for the movie. Sharon doesn't even know what the final mixes will sound like.

'But the likelihood is that they will come to play some part in the biopic, which would be incredible.'

Sharon and son Jack Osbourne have been the driving forces behind the biopic and the film is moving forward, though fans may have a long wait for both the movie and the songs as it is still in development.

Ozzy died of a heart attack on July 22, 2025, at the age of 76, two weeks after he performed his last gig, Back To The Beginning, at Villa Park in Birmingham.

READ MORE: Sharon Osbourne recalls husband Ozzy's final words to her: 'Hold me tight'

article_html:
Ozzy Osbourne may have left millions of fans heartbroken, but his voice will live forever.

According to the latest reports, two previously unheard tracks by the Paranoid hitmaker are set to be released. 

He is said to have secretly worked on several songs with producer Andrew Watt while working on his 2022 album, Patient Number 9.

They are now expected to be made public to coincide with the upcoming movie being made about his life.

READ MORE: Ozzy Osbourne, Prince of Darkness, dies at 76

A source told The Sun: 'Ozzy had a practical outlook about his medical issues and life. He was very excited to be in the studio for the Patient Number 9 sessions because Andrew managed to bring energy and excitement, even though he was struggling with his ailments.

'They worked on the album and Ozzy knew that, with the biopic in development, he saw an idea for works about his life and romance with Sharon. Those tracks have only been heard by Andrew and his musicians.'

The songs are described as still being 'works in progress', and even Ozzy's widow Sharon Osbourne, who managed his career, hasn't heard them.

The insider added: 'The final mixes have not even been finished. They remain works in progress and to be considered for the movie. Sharon doesn't even know what the final mixes will sound like.

'But the likelihood is that they will come to play some part in the biopic, which would be incredible.'

Sharon and son Jack Osbourne have been the driving forces behind the biopic and the film is moving forward, though fans may have a long wait for both the movie and the songs as it is still in development.

Ozzy died of a heart attack on July 22, 2025, at the age of 76, two weeks after he performed his last gig, Back To The Beginning, at Villa Park in Birmingham.

headline: Meghan Markle's ‘painful' struggle revealed amid father's police probe
subheadline: Meghan Markle’s health takes toll of Thomas Markle Sr's distressing allegations
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are reportedly away with their children as schools in UK are on half-term break.

The couple, who have decided to pause their public engagements for the time-being, are dealing with the ongoing investigation of Meghan’s father, Thomas Markle Sr, who has been accused of child abuse and paedophilia.

However, in the latest update from the Sussex camp, the current situation has taken a toll on the Duchess of Sussex and she is “really struggling”.

READ MORE: Meghan Markle's pal reveals why she kept silent on father's allegations

According to Royal Editor Emily Nash, it has been a “very, very difficult and painful moment” for Meghan.

She cited people close to the As Ever founder and described the situation that is in the Sussex household these days.

Meghan is “in bits” but she is surrounded by some close friends.

“She has other friends checking in with her daily,” Emily said, noting this is a situation beyond her control and would take a toll on anyone emotionally.

“On the one hand she’s looking at her own children who are obviously very young, and feeling horrified on behalf of any other children allegedly caught up in this situation,” sources close to Meghan have said.

“But at the same time, there is a sense of relief because it's something that she and Harry have had to carry for a very long time, and people close to them as well.”

There is a “degree of relief” that people now know the full story.

READ MORE: Shocking Palace connection in Meghan's father case comes to light

headline: Kourtney Kardashian, Travis Barker stun with bold Halloween look
subheadline: Kourtney and Travis married in 2022 and have a son named Rocky
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Kourtney Kardashian and Travis Barker gave their Halloween celebration a movie touch this year by dressing up as one of cinema's most famous couples.

The two chose Tony Montana and Elvira Hancock from the 1983 film Scarface and went all out to bring the characters to life.

Kourtney shared many pictures from their photoshoot on Instagram. She wore a blue dress with a white fur coat and a short blonde wig, copying the look of Michelle Pfeiffer's character.

READ MORE: Son calls out Kourtney Kardashian for pretending for cameras

Travis, whereas, also changed his usual style for the occasion. He wore a grey suit, a black wig and large sunglasses to look like Al Pacino's Tony Montana.

The couple, however, even used a yellow vintage car for their pictures. They posed together inside and outside their home in Calabasas, with the music icon getting close to the reality star as they showed off their costumes.

READ MORE: Sydney Sweeney, Scooter Braun give fans glimpse of Halloween looks

Kourtney also gave fans a look at her large diamond ring. She added a famous line from the film to her post: "The eyes, Chico. They never lie."

The two have made dressing up together a Halloween tradition. Last year, they chose Jack and Sally from The Nightmare Before Christmas.

headline: Inde Navarrette 'SNL' debut monologue: Marvel, Shane Gillis dig, and more
subheadline: The 'Obsession' star, 25, makes her 'Saturday Night Live' hosting debut for the Halloween episode
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Inde Navarrette has made her Saturday Night Live hosting debut!

The Obsession star hosted the SNL Halloween episode on Saturday, October 31, with Gracie Abrams as the musical guest. The actress was the perfect fit to host the Halloween episode given that she starred in this year’s most successful horror film, and naturally, she channelled some Nikki into her monologue.

“You probably know me from the movie Obsession, and a lot of people ask me if I’m like my character Nikki, and I’m like, ‘No, no, no don’t do that,’” she joked, referencing the iconic scene from the movie.

READ MORE: Taylor Swift becomes Inde Navarrette's 'SNL' hosting debut muse

Still, the 25-year-old insisted that she’s “nothing like” her character from the Curry Barker film, before revealing her boyfriend taped to his chair in the audience. “My boyfriend is here tonight to support me. We have such a chill relationship. Right, honey?” she said.

Navarette then addressed her recently-confirmed role as Rogue in Marvel Studio’s upcoming X-Men reboot.

“And I know it’s really important to Marvel that you get really fit, so I’ve been working out a lot,” she revealed, before using the opportunity to take a jab at last month’s host, Shane Gillis. “So every morning I put on my little whore outfit and I hit the gym,” she quipped, drawing loud cheers from the audience.

The joke was a reference to Gillis’ controversial monologue on October 10, where he said that women dress like “whores” at the gym.

The Obsession star hosted the SNL Halloween episode on Saturday, October 31, with Gracie Abrams as the musical guest. The actress was the perfect fit to host the Halloween episode given that she starred in this year’s most successful horror film, and naturally, she channelled some Nikki into her monologue.

“You probably know me from the movie Obsession, and a lot of people ask me if I’m like my character Nikki, and I’m like, ‘No, no, no don’t do that,’” she joked, referencing the iconic scene from the movie.

READ MORE: Taylor Swift becomes Inde Navarrette's 'SNL' hosting debut muse

Still, the 25-year-old insisted that she’s “nothing like” her character from the Curry Barker film, before revealing her boyfriend taped to his chair in the audience. “My boyfriend is here tonight to support me. We have such a chill relationship. Right, honey?” she said.

Navarette then addressed her recently-confirmed role as Rogue in Marvel Studio’s upcoming X-Men reboot.

“And I know it’s really important to Marvel that you get really fit, so I’ve been working out a lot,” she revealed, before using the opportunity to take a jab at last month’s host, Shane Gillis. “So every morning I put on my little whore outfit and I hit the gym,” she quipped, drawing loud cheers from the audience.

The joke was a reference to Gillis’ controversial monologue on October 10, where he said that women dress like “whores” at the gym.

headline: Ye makes rap history with record-breaking Halloween concert
subheadline: Ye takes over Houston, drawing a crowd of 80,210 at sold-out concert
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Ye, formerly known as Kanye West turned Houston into the centre of rap history.

The music mogul delivered a historic Halloween night performance at Reliant Stadium on Saturday night October 31.

He reportedly attracted 80,210 fans and set a new record for the highest-attended rap concert in U.S. stadium history.

READ MORE: Kanye West, Bianca Censori Halloween outing comes after family revelations

The enormous turnout makes the Houston show one of the biggest milestones of Ye's live career, putting an extraordinary spotlight on the scale of his latest stadium tour.

The Bully maker performed atop a spectacular spherical stage resembling planet Earth, surrounded by elaborate visuals, lasers and pyrotechnics.

The nearly three-hour show brought together music from his latest album, Bully, alongside career-spanning favourites.

The evening also featured special appearances from Playboi Carti, who joined Ye for several performances, and his daughter North West, who made a memorable appearance onstage.

The rapper brought his Ye Live Concert Tour to Texas, creating a landmark moment in his 2026 touring run.

Moreover, performing with his daughter appeared to be another significant moment for Ye.

He previously shared a message, revealing that his daughter North inspired him to return to music.

On January 21, 2025, Kim Kardashian’s ex wrote about their eldest daughter, "This little girl made me love music again.”

“She asked me to make beats for her I got back on the ASR [sampler], chopping up beats. For the album, I chopped every beat with my bare hands,” he added.

READ MORE: North West talks about ‘crazy-fast' rapping lesson dad Ye taught her

headline: Gracie Abrams recreates iconic 'Romeo and Juliet' scene on 'SNL'
subheadline: Gracie Abrams' outfit was inspired by Leonardo DiCaprio's character
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Gracie Abrams made her Halloween appearance on Saturday Night Live extra special by bringing two famous looks from the movie Romeo + Juliet to the stage.

The singer took inspiration from the 1996 film and surprised viewers by changing her costume for her second performance.

Abrams first appeared in a white angel costume, just like the one worn by Claire Danes in the movie.

She chose the look for her performance of Hit the Wall, a song from her third album, 'Daughter from Hell.' The singer, however, even started singing from behind an aquarium, bringing back a scene that fans of the film would remember.

The singer got another surprise waiting for the audience later in the show as well. For her second performance, she sang Here You Come, There You Go from the deluxe album.

READ MORE: Gracie Abrams fans unlock 'Daughter From Hell' surprise after new single

So this time, her outfit was inspired by Leonardo DiCaprio's character as the That’s So True hitmaker wore a tropical button down shirt along with metal sleeves that looked like part of the suit of armor worn in the movie.

The performances gave Abrams a fun way to celebrate Halloween while paying tribute to a film she clearly wanted to bring to life on stage.

READ MORE: Kourtney Kardashian, Travis Barker stun with bold Halloween look

It was also her second time as the show's musical guest after her first appearance in 2024.

headline: William, Kate share George, Charlotte, Louis photo amid Halloween buzz
subheadline: Prince William, Princess Kate share family picture as George Eton break continues
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince William and Princess Kate delighted fans with a family photo amid the ongoing excitement surrounding Halloween looks.

On November 1, the Prince and Princess of Wales shared special memories of the past few months, including a heartfelt family outing at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games.

The Waleses' kids, George, Charlotte and Louis, joined their parents in Scotland to witness some games and interacted with the volunteers and athletes.

READ MORE: Kensington Palace shares rare treat of William and Kate's bundle of joy

While sharing their Autumn Rewind, William and Catherine shared a family photo, taken from behind as their first slide.

The couple also honoured many of their meaningful engagements, including suicide prevention talks and the upcoming Earthshot Prize promotion, which William participated in by playing a cricket match in front of Buckingham Palace.

They captioned their new post, "The Autumn Rewind. Thank you to everyone who has been a part of it!"

According to reports, the family is currently keeping a low profile and enjoying some time away from the spotlight as Prince George's Eton break continues.

READ MORE: Prince William, Kate dragged into Meghan's controversy with new claim

headline: Drone 'used for surveillance' crashes into CTD headquarters in Lahore
subheadline: Police say drone's cameras, battery lights were operational when recovered
author: Ahmed Faraz
article_text:
Drone crashes into CTD headquarters’ outer wall.
Police suspect facility was being surveyed.
Authorities launch investigation into security breach.

LAHORE: A drone allegedly being used to conduct surveillance of the Counter Terrorism Department (CTD) headquarters crashed into the facility’s outer wall in Lahore, police said on Sunday.

According to police, the drone approached the CTD headquarters from the Jallo More side before striking the outer wall and falling to the ground.

The security team deployed at the headquarters immediately took the drone into custody. Police said the cameras attached to the drone as well as its battery lights were operational when it was recovered.

Police suspected that unidentified individuals had sent the drone towards the CTD headquarters to conduct reconnaissance of areas inside the facility.

Authorities said an investigation had been launched from all angles to determine who was operating the drone and the purpose behind the alleged surveillance.

The CTD headquarters’ security officials also submitted an application at the Harbanspura police station seeking legal action over the incident.

• Drone crashes into CTD headquarters’ outer wall.
  • Police suspect facility was being surveyed.
  • Authorities launch investigation into security breach.

LAHORE: A drone allegedly being used to conduct surveillance of the Counter Terrorism Department (CTD) headquarters crashed into the facility’s outer wall in Lahore, police said on Sunday.

According to police, the drone approached the CTD headquarters from the Jallo More side before striking the outer wall and falling to the ground.

The security team deployed at the headquarters immediately took the drone into custody. Police said the cameras attached to the drone as well as its battery lights were operational when it was recovered.

Police suspected that unidentified individuals had sent the drone towards the CTD headquarters to conduct reconnaissance of areas inside the facility.

Authorities said an investigation had been launched from all angles to determine who was operating the drone and the purpose behind the alleged surveillance.

The CTD headquarters’ security officials also submitted an application at the Harbanspura police station seeking legal action over the incident.

headline: Harry Styles breaks down on stage after record-breaking MSG Residency
subheadline: Jalen Brunson makes special appearance during Harry Styles emotional MSG finale
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Harry Styles struggled to hold back his emotions as he brought his record-breaking Together, Together residency at New York's Madison Square Garden to an end.

The 30-night run was wrapped up on October 31, leaving fans with a finale that was as heartbreaking as it was celebratory.

In an emotional video circulating online, the former One Direction star can be seen waving goodbye to the crowd before placing both hands over his heart as he began to cry.

READ MORE: Harry Styles recreates his 16-year-old ‘X Factor' audition look at Harryween

Overwhelmed by the moment, he eventually turns his back to the cameras, seemingly trying to hide his emotions.

But there was no hiding the feeling in the room, as fans watched their favourite superstar take in the magnitude of what he had accomplished.

Another moment made the evening even more special. New York Knicks star Jalen Brunson surprised the Watermelon Sugar hitmaker by presenting him with a commemorative banner celebrating his incredible 30-night MSG residency.

The special recognition appeared to make the singer visibly emotional as he reflected on the remarkable run.

The Halloween finale also brought back Harry's playful side. Dressed as New York's infamous Pizza Rat, complete with the cheeky reference to the viral subway rat carrying a slice of pizza, he turned the final night into a celebration of the city.

His band members joined the fun by dressing as iconic New York landmarks, while the group performed Talking Heads' Psycho Killer.

Thirty nights, more than half a million fans and a moment Harry will probably never forget.

headline: King Charles and Queen set for memorable meeting with West Indies cricket team
subheadline: King Charles and Queen Camilla join Antigua’s biggest independence celebrations
author: Web Desk
article_text:
King Charles and Queen Camilla are set for a day of national celebrations for Antigua and Barbuda's 45th annual Independence Parade.

The royal couple will attend the landmark event, which brings together military and uniformed groups for a colourful display of ceremonial marching in honour of the island nation’s independence and national pride.

The celebrations will also give Charles and Camilla the chance to meet some of the country’s most respected figures, with guests recognised for their contributions to public life across culture, sport, education and community service.

Read More: King Charles faces end of tradition last upheld by Queen Elizabeth II

Among the highlights will be a meeting with four celebrated West Indies cricket legends: Sir Viv Richards, Sir Richie Richardson, Sir Andy Roberts and Sir Curtly Ambrose.

King and Queen will also watch the parade’s closing ceremonial sequence before greeting students attending the occasion.

Festivities will take place at the Sir Vivian Richards Stadium, where the King is also scheduled to hold separate audiences with Prime Minister Gaston Browne and Governor-General Sir Rodney Williams, his official representative in Antigua and Barbuda.

The visit forms the final leg of Charles and Camilla’s nine-day Caribbean tour, with the King preparing for another major engagement on Tuesday when he opens the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM), hosted by Antigua and Barbuda.

headline: Prince Harry finally reacts to William's 'no forgiveness' rule
subheadline: Prince William paying no attention to Harry's back-to-back reconciliation attempts
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince Harry revealed his true feelings over the constant 'rejection' from his estranged brother Prince William's side regarding reconciliation.

Before and after his return to the UK, the Duke of Sussex has made multiple attempts to show his interest in making amends with the royal family, including William.

Most recently, in conversation with GQ, Harry said that he wants to make things work out with his father and brother.

READ MORE: William, Kate share George, Charlotte, Louis photo amid Halloween buzz

According to reports, the future king has not yet responded to Harry's pleas.

An insider told RadarOnline.com that William's behaviour left Harry shocked and furious.

The source said, "William's acting like Harry and Meghan don't exist. Ignoring Harry is his way of handling what he considers to be a wretchedly unpleasant situation. It's infuriating to him (Harry).

"Harry's known to be impulsive, and the more wound up he gets, the more likely he is to follow through on threats to make William regret this.

READ MORE: Princess Kate receives gracious message from Harry ahead of key event

"He insists he's tried to find every possible way to say that he's sorry. He's genuinely shocked that there's not even been a shred of forgiveness on William's part."

headline: Diddy hit with another setback as old controversy returns
subheadline: Dawn Richard says she already moved on from working with Diddy
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Dawn Richard has made new claim about Diddy, saying he used her old vocals on his 2023 album without her permission.

Although her voice can be heard on 'The Love Album: Off the Grid,' the singer says she got no part in making the record and didn’t work with him for many years.

Richard spoke about the issue during an interview with Angela Yee on October 20. She was there to talk about her new album 'Creole Culture' but the conversation also brought up her past work with Diddy.

She, however, explained that the vocals he used were not new recordings. They were actually made while she was working with his group Diddy Dirty Money, on its 2010 album 'Last Train to Paris.'

READ MORE: Diddy faces major prison setback after VIP treatment ended

The singer said she already moved on from working with Diddy when the vocals appeared on his later album.

"He stole that vocal. That was a Dirty Money song," she said during the interview.

Richard also remembered how hard it was to speak about her past during Diddy's trial, saying going through those memories again was painful.

READ MORE: Gracie Abrams recreates iconic 'Romeo and Juliet' scene on 'SNL'

Her comments came after a judge dismissed her 2024 lawsuit against Diddy in June because most of her claims were filed too late.

article_html:
Dawn Richard has made new claim about Diddy, saying he used her old vocals on his 2023 album without her permission.

Although her voice can be heard on 'The Love Album: Off the Grid,' the singer says she got no part in making the record and didn’t work with him for many years.

Richard spoke about the issue during an interview with Angela Yee on October 20. She was there to talk about her new album 'Creole Culture' but the conversation also brought up her past work with Diddy.

She, however, explained that the vocals he used were not new recordings. They were actually made while she was working with his group Diddy Dirty Money, on its 2010 album 'Last Train to Paris.'

READ MORE: Diddy faces major prison setback after VIP treatment ended

The singer said she already moved on from working with Diddy when the vocals appeared on his later album.

"He stole that vocal. That was a Dirty Money song," she said during the interview.

Richard also remembered how hard it was to speak about her past during Diddy's trial, saying going through those memories again was painful.

Her comments came after a judge dismissed her 2024 lawsuit against Diddy in June because most of her claims were filed too late.

headline: Queen Sonja steps out in vibrant pink for first royal trip abroad
subheadline: Queen Sonja breaks silence on tragic train crash during return to royal duties
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Norway’s Queen Sonja has made her first overseas trip since the death of her husband, King Harald.

The 89-year-old royal travelled to Málaga during the week, where she attended an exhibition opening and spent time with pupils at a Norwegian school.

Her visit came just weeks after she resumed her public duties following a period of mourning.

Read More: Queen Sonja's final red rose for King Harald leaves Oslo Cathedral in tears

A red carpet was laid out for her arrival, as delighted pupils gathered at the school gates to welcome the Queen with bunches of flowers.

She later met the students and enjoyed a musical performance by the young performers.

Queen Sonja pays tribute to victims of tragic train crash

Before her school visit, the Queen attended the opening of the Munch-Picasso exhibition at Málaga's Picasso Museum on 29 October.

"Allow me, first of all, to say that I was deeply saddened to learn of the terrible train accident that took place yesterday near Toledo," she said.

She continued: "My thoughts are with those who have lost their loved ones, with their families and friends, and with all those affected by this tragic event."

The Queen also offered her "heartfelt condolences and my deepest sympathy to everyone who is grieving at this very difficult time."

Read More: Queen Sonja marks her anniversary by looking out at crowds

headline: Afghan Taliban cannot absorb 'punishment' Pakistan can inflict: ISPR DG
subheadline: Military spokesperson says Pakistan has capability, strategy to impose cost over terrorism
author: Web Desk
article_text:
ISPR DG warns Taliban against testing Pakistan.
Says Kabul regime harbouring terrorist leaders.
Says military adapting to changing warfare technologies.

RAWALPINDI: The Afghan Taliban do not have the capability to absorb the “punishment” Pakistan can inflict in response to threats emanating from Afghanistan, the military’s spokesperson has warned.

Director General Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) Lt Gen Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry told Reuters Pakistan possessed the capability to counter threats from the Afghan Taliban, including those involving drones, and was prepared for attempts to test its operational readiness.

“Whatever they want to send, they can; they may try. We have the capability to take them on,” the ISPR DG said in an interview.

“They don’t have, I think, the capability to then absorb the punishment that we can put on them,” he added.

The military spokesperson was responding to a question about the potential threat posed by drones in the hands of the Afghan Taliban and whether Pakistan could face a situation similar to drone threats elsewhere in the region.

Lt Gen Chaudhry said that whatever drone capability the Afghan Taliban possessed was not indigenous, saying that such technology was being supplied by their sponsors.

The ISPR DG said that India is the “biggest terror sponsor” in the context of threats facing Pakistan and added that the Afghan Taliban and terrorist groups operating against Pakistan were acting as Indian proxies.

Referring to Pakistan’s previous conflict with India, he said New Delhi had sent “dozens and dozens” of sophisticated drones, which Pakistan successfully countered.

“We turned them into dust everywhere,” he said, adding that Pakistan had since moved further ahead in terms of its operational readiness.

'There will be a cost'

The ISPR DG also said that the Afghan Taliban regime is harbouring terrorist leaders and allowing armed groups to operate from Afghan soil against Pakistan.

He said Islamabad was not seeking Afghanistan’s isolation and remained engaged with Kabul, but expected the Afghan Taliban to “act like a state” and prevent terrorism from its territory.

“We only ask you that don’t support terrorism inside Pakistan. Stop harbouring the terrorist leaders,” he said.

The spokesperson said that terrorist formations were coming from Afghanistan and receiving weapons from there, while Afghan citizens and even personnel of the Taliban regime had been found among groups involved in attacks against Pakistan.

“If you do it, then there will be a cost,” he warned. “And we are capable of imposing that cost and we have a clear strategy how to impose that cost.”

He also said that Afghanistan are providing an environment where multiple militant organisations were able to operate, while rejecting allegations that Pakistan was hosting or coordinating anti-Taliban elements.

'Afghanistan producing terrorism and drugs'

Rejecting the suggestion that Kabul should be isolated, the ISPR DG said the international community and regional countries instead needed to engage the Afghan Taliban and press them to behave like a state.

“What Afghanistan is producing right now, it has only two products: terrorism and drugs,” he said, adding that both posed threats to the region and the wider world.

The spokesperson said Pakistan had no interest in dictating how Afghanistan should be governed, maintaining that this was for Afghans to decide.

He stressed, however, that armed groups, militias and mercenaries could not be tolerated by any state.

Pakistan Army 'technology-savvy'

Discussing the changing nature of warfare, the ISPR DG said the Pakistan Army was adapting its capabilities to emerging threats across conventional and non-contact warfare, including drones and cyber technologies.

He said the proliferation of non-contact warfare capabilities among non-state actors posed a threat that required countries to reassess their security architecture.

Asked whether the military used artificial intelligence to identify targets in Afghanistan, the spokesperson declined to disclose operational details.

“I cannot go into specifics [about] how we are using AI, how we are using quantum technology, how we are using cyber technology, or how we are using multiple other technologies,” he said.

“But we are using all sorts of technologies. We are a technology-savvy army.”

headline: World Bank approves $150m programme to improve municipal services in Sindh
subheadline: Initiative will benefit 25 local councils in Karachi, serving a population of 3.58 million, says lender
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Programme targets improved property tax collection.
Karachi's annual property tax target rises to $85m.
70% of property tax revenue to fund local services.

The World Bank has approved $150 million in financing for a programme aimed at improving urban property tax collection and strengthening municipal service delivery in Sindh.

The World Bank Group's Board of Executive Directors approved the financing for the Sindh Property Revenues Enhancement Program (Sindh PREP) on October 30, a statement read.

"Cities that can raise their own revenues can plan and invest for the long term," said Bolormaa Amgaabazar, World Bank Country Director for Pakistan.

"Today, Sindh's local councils depend on provincial transfers for more than 95% of their revenues. By helping Karachi collect the property taxes from its residents and businesses, and by reinvesting most of that revenue in local services, this programme will give Sindh's cities the means to finance the infrastructure they need," she added.

The Sindh PREP will support the provincial government in improving urban immovable property tax (UIPT) collection and strengthening municipal service delivery capacity in selected local councils.

Despite being one of the world's largest cities, Karachi currently collects only around $8.5 million annually in property tax, while cities of similar size collect between 82 and 350 times more.

The programme aims to increase Karachi's annual property tax collection to $85 million and raise compliance from 20% to 50%.

It will achieve this by strengthening property tax collection, compliance and administration, including through the introduction of a UIPT management information system for billing, payment processing and grievance redress. Integrated financial management information systems will also be rolled out across local councils.

Around 70% of the collected property tax revenue will be reinvested directly into municipal infrastructure and services in participating local councils.

The programme will benefit Karachi's 25 local councils, with 3.58 million people living in these areas identified as its primary beneficiaries.

Funding will be linked to results, with annual performance assessments conducted by an Independent Verification Agent determining the awards each council receives.

These awards will finance the rehabilitation of climate-resilient municipal infrastructure and services, including drainage, sewerage, schools, fire stations, roads and street lighting.

The programme also includes a $40 million Investment Project Financing component to expand property surveys and property tax administration to 20 local councils in other urban centres of Sindh.

Around 4.5 million people in these areas are expected to benefit indirectly.

headline: Princess Anne makes rare remark about power of connection in London
subheadline: Princess Anne shares thoughtful words on one thing she believes brings people closer together
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Princess Anne has shared her thoughts on the power of bringing people together during a creative evening in London.

The Princess Royal attended the 2026 Patron’s Lecture at the Royal Society of Arts (RSA) on 2 October, where she praised the organisation’s fellowship and the value of exchanging ideas.

Speaking about the community, Anne described the RSA Fellowship as “a truly extraordinary resource”, adding: “I think people do this better when they meet together.”

Read More: Princess Anne takes on £15m royal opening celebrating Britain's elite commandos

As Patron of the RSA, Princess Anne joined an event focused on creativity, education and the role of collaboration in turning new ideas into reality.

The lecture was delivered by writer and activist Scarlett Curtis, who explored how creative thinking can move beyond imagination and find its place in everyday life.

Following the lecture, Scarlett joined Deborah Meaden, Liv Little and Richard Curtis for a panel discussion on creativity, arts education and the importance of giving people the freedom to experiment.

The evening also saw the launch of a new RSA pocketbook, How Ideas Get Made, which looks at the conditions that allow different minds to flourish and creative ideas to take shape.

Read More: Princess Anne announces new overseas trip with major engagement in November

headline: LPG 'crisis' grips Pakistan ahead of winter; prices climb as high as Rs700 per kg
subheadline: Supply disruption at Taftan border triggers shortage as official price rises
author: Web Desk
article_text:
LPG unavailable at official Rs294 per kg.
Prices reach Rs700 per kg in Balochistan.
Petroleum minister assures ample gas supply in winter.

Pakistan is facing a severe liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) shortage ahead of winter as supplies through the Taftan border remain suspended, pushing retail prices to as high as Rs700 per kilogramme in parts of the country, Geo News reported on Sunday.

The shortage comes as the official LPG price has also been increased by Rs14 per kg to Rs294 per kg, according to a notification. However, consumers said the commodity was not available at the government-notified rate.

In Quetta and other parts of Balochistan, LPG was being sold for between Rs530 and Rs700 per kg, while prices in Karachi and Lahore ranged from Rs520 to Rs580 per kg.

In Peshawar, the commodity was selling for between Rs600 and Rs650 per kg.

Consumers in Lahore, meanwhile, said LPG was being sold at shops for Rs550 to Rs600 per kg despite the official price of Rs294, calling on the government to bring prices down.

Hormuz situation affecting oil, gas prices

Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik, speaking at a private university’s convocation in Lahore, said uncertainty surrounding the Strait of Hormuz had affected oil and gas prices.

He said Pakistan had successfully navigated the situation over the past six months and maintained that petroleum prices were determined through a transparent mechanism.

Malik said gas supplies were arriving from Qatar and assured that ample supplies would continue during December and January.

He also said the government was providing subsidised petrol to low-income people.

LPG marketers raise concerns over proposed policy

Meanwhile, Pakistan LPG Marketers Association Senior Vice President Ali Haider said a summary concerning the LPG pricing policy had been sent to the prime minister.

Haider said the proposed policy would make LPG 25% to 30% more expensive and maintained that it had been formulated without consultation with stakeholders.

He said higher LPG prices would hurt both businesses and consumers and called on the government to deregulate the sector.
